en: The postcard is a colored, vintage-style illustration of a hilly urban area with clusters of classical European buildings, including homes, churches, and larger structures scattered among green hills. There is a handwritten message in German covering the lower portion and some of the upper part of the card. Printed German text reads 'Gruß aus Graz. Ruckerlberg.' indicating the scene is from Graz, specifically the Ruckerlberg area. The publisher 'Schneider & Lux, Wien, V.' is also printed at the bottom.
